_description: Maps role types to Sav's pre-approved resume PDFs. Pipeline picks the right resume — no regeneration. Updated 2026-06-24 to the new 4-archetype resume set (replaces the prior 5-cluster set; partnerships + PMM now fold into enterprise_growth).
_usage: Honor an explicit Notion 'Resume Version' first (see lib/resume-picker.mjs clusterFromVersion); otherwise match role title/JD against best_for (first match wins); else use the default.
_provenance_note: Each entry's 'source' records the Drive file + its modifiedTime at ingest. To check staleness: compare Drive's current 'Modified' date against source.drive_modified — if Drive is newer, re-ingest (re-read the PDF, refresh angle/best_for, bump _resume_set_updated).

_contact_on_resumes._note: These 4 resumes use the ensolabs.ai contact. Keep config/candidate.json in sync so generated cover letters match.

forward_deployed.headline: Forward-Deployed AI Architect · AI Transformation · Agentic Systems · Enterprise GTM
forward_deployed.angle: The most technical variant. Leads with hands-on production builds: agentic workflows on Claude + MCP, Google ADK / Managed Agents, LangGraph; autonomous financial AI agents; a 731-document enterprise intelligence platform. Frontier-platform builder (Google I/O 2026 partner). Use when the role wants someone who architects AND ships, embedded with client engineering.

managed_services.headline: AI Transformation · Managed Services · Agentic Systems
managed_services.angle: Advisory + managed-services / MD variant. Leads with a productized retainer practice (Claude Managed Services — offering, pricing, intake, delivery playbooks), MD-level delivery, and 'sell the roadmap then stand up the platform.' Best for consulting firms, fractional/contract, and managed-delivery mandates.

enterprise_growth.headline: Enterprise Growth & AI Strategy · Perplexity AI Business Fellow · 20+ Live Deployments
enterprise_growth.angle: Growth / GTM / commercial variant. Leads with closing-and-expanding AI engagements, enterprise product demonstrations as proof-of-depth, BD and account growth, and moving deals first-conversation to production. Absorbs the old partnerships + product-marketing clusters. Best for GTM-engineer, sales-engineering, BD, partnerships, and growth roles.

ai_transformation.headline: AI Transformation & Growth Strategy · Enterprise Advisory & Agentic AI Deployment
ai_transformation.angle: The generalist / master resume — balanced enterprise AI advisory + transformation strategy + growth, with hands-on credibility. The default when a role is broad AI leadership and doesn't clearly fit a more specialized variant.

matching_rules.priority: 1) explicit Notion Resume Version → cluster (clusterFromVersion); 2) title keyword vs best_for, first match wins (order: forward_deployed, managed_services, enterprise_growth, ai_transformation); 3) default.

legacy_version_aliases._note: Old Notion rows used keys like 'v3', 'PMM_v2', 'ForwardDeployed', 'MD_ManagedServices' — these still route correctly to the new files.

matching_rules.notes: These are Sav's pre-approved PDFs. Do NOT regenerate resumes. Pick the best match and submit the PDF as-is. PDFs live in materials/resumes/ (gitignored). Place the 4 new files there on the Mac before submitting.
